title: VanillaUnbound
description: Vanilla Unbound is a Fabric modpack that enhances Minecraft’s visuals, animations, particles, and UI feedback to make the game feel more alive and immersive
body:
**Vanilla Unbound** is a Vanilla Fabric modpack focused on improving Minecraft's visuals, animations, and immersion without changing the core gameplay experience.

This pack enhances the world with smoother animations, improved interaction feedback, ambient particles, and visual polish that make Minecraft feel more alive and responsive. From animated doors and jukeboxes to enhanced combat and environmental effects.

### Features

* Improved UI and hotbar animations
* Enhanced visual feedback for combat and interactions
* Ambient particles and environmental effects
* Animated world interactions and block behavior
* Immersive visual details that stay true to vanilla
* No major gameplay changes or progression overhauls
